UX-2 · quick look before any prototype · proposal · 2026-10-20

A4 · Account statement

Utility-professional, soft on the eyes: every reply that settles something reads like a calm statement panel on a warm, low-glare ground. These are fast static mockups so you can judge the colours and feel. Nothing here is clickable; the full prototype gets built only after you pick. Source: docs/design/DESIGN-DIRECTIONS.md § A4. Fonts load from Google Fonts with a system fallback.
